name: Differential Power Analysis
description: Statistical analysis of multiple power consumption traces to extract secret keys from cryptographic implementations. Covers DPA, CPA (Correlation Power Analysis), and higher-order attacks. Includes trace acquisition campaign design, trace alignment and preprocessing, leakage model selection, statistical distinguisher application, and key rank estimation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to statistical power analysis techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the statistical foundations of DPA/CPA and the divide-and-conquer approach
evidence: Can explain the difference-of-means DPA attack and CPA with Pearson correlation
Understands the divide-and-conquer principle applied to key byte recovery
Aware of the role of trace count, noise, and alignment in attack success

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Executes DPA/CPA attacks on training targets using existing tooling under supervision
evidence: Captures a trace set of sufficient quality for CPA on a ChipWhisperer training target
Runs CPA attack using provided scripts and correctly interprets correlation peaks
Applies basic trace alignment (sum-of-absolute-differences, static alignment) to acquired traces
Recovers AES-128 key bytes on an unprotected implementation under guidance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and executes DPA/CPA campaigns against real targets
evidence: Designs trace acquisition campaigns (trigger setup, trace count estimation, sampling parameters)
Applies appropriate leakage models (HW, HD, identity) and selects optimal attack points
Recovers full AES keys from unprotected and lightly protected implementations independently
Evaluates attack results using key rank estimation and success metrics
Produced DPA/CPA reports on 3+ real engagements meeting lab standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Executes higher-order attacks; defeats countermeasures; develops analysis tooling
evidence: Performs second-order and higher-order DPA to defeat masking countermeasures
Applies advanced preprocessing (PCA, LDA, integration) to improve leakage extraction
Develops custom CPA/DPA analysis pipelines and attack scripts for the lab
Assesses the effectiveness of side-channel countermeasures quantitatively (TVLA, SNR analysis)
Mentors junior analysts on statistical analysis and attack optimization

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on statistical power analysis; publishes novel attacks; defines methodology
evidence: Published research on novel DPA/CPA techniques at conferences (CHES, COSADE, CARDIS)
Develops the lab's DPA methodology aligned with Common Criteria and EMVCo evaluation standards
Applies machine-learning-based side-channel attacks to production targets
Provides expert consultation on DPA resistance to silicon designers and certification bodies

assessment_methods.description: Plan and execute a complete CPA campaign against a prepared target: design acquisition parameters, capture traces, run the attack, and report recovered key material with confidence metrics
Review DPA/CPA analysis reports from recent engagements for statistical rigor and methodology compliance

equipment: ChipWhisperer-Pro or equivalent high-resolution acquisition platform
Low-noise amplifier (LNA) for power measurement chain
EM probe station with near-field probes (for EM-assisted DPA)
